prompts.terrain_source:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production terrain source atlas for a 2D side scrolling pixel art Metroidvania, ENV-01 Milk Spring Camp.
Create a square 1024x1024 image containing a perfect 4-column by 4-row grid of 16 terrain tiles, no labels, no gutters, each 256x256 square corresponding to 16x16 game pixels shown at 16x nearest-neighbor scale. Use true transparent background only outside exposed tile silhouettes.
Art direction: original friendly milk fantasy, warm safe settlement, crisp hand-placed pixel clusters, terracotta compact soil with small cream stones, golden moss grass on the top, warm brown wood for thin platforms. Cohesive restricted warm palette, dark brown outlines on exposed borders only, each virtual pixel is a solid 16x16 block; no blur, no lighting gradients, no antialiasing.
Exact atlas semantics in row-major order:
row1: terrain upper-left outer corner, top edge with grass, upper-right outer corner, left vertical edge.
row2: center dirt fill completely opaque with no outline anywhere, right vertical edge, bottom-left outer corner, bottom edge.
row3: bottom-right outer corner, single floating grassy block outlined on all exposed sides, thin wooden platform left end, thin wooden platform repeatable middle.
row4: thin wooden platform right end, concave grassy inner-left corner, concave grassy inner-right corner, camp-to-forest transition top tile.
Ground tile tops line up; dirt texture must repeat without black gridlines. Matching left/right and top/bottom pixel seams. For edge tiles transparency is only beyond their exposed outer silhouette, interior join edges remain fully opaque. Thin platform has a flat walkable top at 1 virtual pixel and is 6 virtual pixels thick, transparent below.
No characters, no text, no watermark, no grid drawn, no icons. Each tile completely inside its own cell.
prompts.background_source:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless low-contrast far background panorama for 640x360 pixel-art side-scrolling game ENV-01 Milk Spring Camp.
Generate a 16:9 wide 1536x864 artwork with crisp pixel art clusters and minimal 24 color palette. This is background scenery only, no gameplay platforms and no walkable foreground. Warm quiet woodland settlement at twilight. The darkest base is warm #1a1614, with distant rounded milk-colored hills, charcoal cocoa tree trunks framing the extreme left and right, desaturated brown and amber forest silhouettes and a few tiny distant roof silhouettes. An open quiet central clearing, low contrast, large clean negative space. Very faint warm stars, no bright sun or bloom. A few soft amber glimmers in far windows.
The bottom quarter is a darker empty low-detail band, suitable for overlaid terrain and characters. No sharp horizontal ground ledge. Everything looks distant with restrained contrast; no crisp foreground props. Crisp square pixels, flat limited tones, no blur, no smooth gradients, no painterly shading.
No people, no characters, no creatures, no text, no logo, no UI, no frame. Background must cover the whole opaque canvas. Harmonious original milk-fantasy aesthetic, side view rather than top down. Outer vertical edges have matching dark tone so repeated background panels have no bright seam.
prompts.scenery_source:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ENV-01 modular scenery source sprite sheet with true transparent background for 16px-grid 2D side scrolling game.
Square 1024x1024 image. Exactly 8 separate complete objects arranged in a 2-column by 4-row layout, every cell 512x256; no overlap, generous transparent padding around every object, no text or labels. Crisp pixel art with uniform square virtual pixels and nearest-neighbor look, warm restrained 24-color palette, warm brown outline, original rounded milk-fantasy settlement design, readable at small size. Flat side/front elevation for side scrolling, not isometric. Each object rests on a straight horizontal baseline. All objects viewable as reusable transparent sprites.
row1 left: small wood and cream canvas merchant cottage with rounded pale milk-bottle chimney, warm amber window, open dark doorway, tiled warm brown roof; right: cream canvas camping tent with wooden poles, no signage.
row2 left: low wide circular stone milk spring fountain, cream-white milk surface and small stone central spout, subtle small milk droplets, empty of characters; right: freestanding wooden merchant shelf with three levels holding cream milk bottles, brown jars and rolled maps with no marks.
row3 left: small cozy orange campfire surrounded by rounded brown stones, short logs, no smoke cut off; right: closed rounded wooden storage chest reinforced with dark brown bands and a small cream clasp.
row4 left: freestanding timber doorway return arch, rounded wood beam and faint milk-blue swirl entirely inside dark opening, no ground chunk; right: stack of two wooden crates beside a small blank wooden direction sign, no writing.
No background shadow plane, no ground slab, no fake checkerboard. Preserve actual alpha between and around objects. No people, no animals, no logos, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Pixel silhouettes complete inside cells.
prompts.interior_source:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: background layer for a merchant house interior, 640x360 logical side-view pixel-art Metroidvania.
Generate a wide 16:9 pixel art backdrop, no characters and no foreground furniture. Original round milk-fantasy cozy cottage interior. Flat front-facing elevation, thick dark timber beams at the corners, brown plaster and wood plank back wall, cream trim, a small arched amber window in upper left, empty small wall niches, sloping rafters at upper corners, a clear recessed open doorway to outside on the right. Ground-floor baseline reserved empty across the bottom 60 pixels, no steps, no terrain platform. The whole central wall remains open and uncluttered so separate shelves and characters can be placed. One small hanging amber lantern high on left. No shelves or shop objects already embedded.
Strict crisp pixel art, 24 restrained warm colors, wood outlines, #1a1614 shadow base, low contrast background details. Flat color clusters and solid square pixels, no blur or smooth painting. Atmosphere warm and safe. No text, signs, logos, UI, people, animals, or watermarks. All edges cover the opaque canvas.
